Name: MH Sort Inventory
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Sort Inventory[/center][/b][/size]Adds convenient sorting buttons to your player inventory that let you organize your items by name, quality, ID, stack size, category, bundle, price or stack price with just a click. 

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Two UI buttons on the left side of your inventory menu
[list]
[*]Sort Direction button: Toggles between Ascending ↑ and Descending ↓
[*]Sort Type button: Cycles through Name → Quality → ID → Stack → Category → Bundle → Price → Stack Price → Number of times a seed has been planted (Requires More Seed Info)
[/list][*]Configurable keybinds for each sort type
[*]Buttons can be hidden via config if you only want keybinds
[*]Automatically detects and respects locked/favorited items from Convenient Inventory
[*]Manual Slot Locking[b],[/b] Lock specific inventory slots even without Convenient Inventory
[/list]

[size=5][b]Sorting Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]By Name:[/b] Alphabetically sorts items by display name
[*][b]By Quality:[/b] Groups items by quality
[*][b]By ID:[/b] Sorts items by their internal item ID
[*][b]By Stack:[/b] Organizes by stack size
[*][b]By Category:[/b] Groups items by type
[*]
[*][b]By Bundle:[/b] Groups items by need send a bundle.
[*][b]By Price: [/b]Sort items by price.
[*][b]By Stack Price:[/b] Sort items by Stack Price.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size][list]
[*]The description has been translated from Spanish
[*]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/180151839]babymo7[/url] for testing android version
[/list]

Manifest.Name: MH Sort Inventory
Manifest.Description: Adds buttons to sort player inventory by name, quality, ID, stack size, category, bundle requirement, sell price, stack value, season, or times planted (with MoreSeedInfo) in ascending or descending order. Right-click for dropdown menu. Respects favorited items from Convenient Inventory. Enable/disable sort types in config. Mobile compatible!
